complexity.notes: Correct but exponentially slow; even n = 45 takes long. ||Memoizing the recursion (or iterating bottom-up keeping two running values)|| brings this to O(n) time, since ||each subproblem only needs to be solved once||.
complexity.summary: Plain recursive enumeration of the Fibonacci recurrence: ways(n) = ways(n-1) + ways(n-2), with base cases at n = 0 and negative n. Every call branches twice with no caching, so overlapping subproblems are recomputed exponentially many times.
